question: How should the composite form be divided between the Great Lord and Viṣṇu?
premises: The procedure follows the previous method.
Half is assigned to the Great Lord.
The other half is assigned to Viṣṇu.
inference: As before, one should make half the form of the Great Lord and the other half of Viṣṇu.
plain_english: Having done as before, make half as the Great Lord and the other half as Viṣṇu.
